entries.description: Validate arbitrary JSON Lines text using standard JSON object rules. Return counts of physical lines, blank lines and objects, plus 1-based invalid-JSON and non-object line numbers. Accept text and an optional report output path. Handle empty input, CRLF and Unicode; reject nonstandard numeric constants. Uses only the Python standard library, with all input and output locations supplied by the caller.

Check a rendered screenshot without image libraries: decode a PNG with the Python standard library (8- and 16-bit, grey, RGB, alpha and palette images), sample pixels on a grid, and report whether it is blank, made of flat colour blocks, or has real content.
